channel.title: Shane's Daily Briefing (Private)
channel.description: A private daily news briefing: AI/Anthropic, world news, Ireland, Central Oregon, and sports (Man Utd, Seahawks). Not intended for public distribution.
channel.itunes:author: sgalligan

item.title: Daily Briefing — Wednesday, September 30, 2026
item.description: Anthropic's Claude-assisted enzyme discovery, its Accenture partnership, and new Life Sciences Verification Program; Salesforce's record Q1 FY27 results and new Agentforce Operations push; the end of the 43-day US government shutdown and Ukraine drone-defense tech; Ireland's power outages and public sector strike; Central Oregon wildfire insurance protections and Pacific Power Foundation grants; a warm, dry stretch of Bend weather; Man Utd's mixed run of results; and the Seahawks' loss to the Commanders.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Tuesday, September 29, 2026
item.description: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5.5 and touts an enzyme-system discovery and an Ebola-response assist; Salesforce unveils AIforce and its Claudeforce integration with Anthropic's Claude; Pope Leo's France visit and a deadly Russian strike on Kyiv; Ireland's Budget 2027 fights over minimum wage and carer's allowance; Bend's Tactics Board Shop closes and Habitat breaks ground at Stone Creek Commons; a dry, mild week of Bend weather; Man Utd's build-up to hosting Tottenham; and the Seahawks regroup after their win streak ends against the Commanders.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Monday, September 28, 2026
item.description: Anthropic's continued safety/verification push alongside its enzyme-discovery story; Salesforce's new Agentforce Help Agent and Commerce release; the UN General Assembly and Germany's political shift; Northern Ireland's Garvaghy Road parade standoff and Ireland's budget fights; Central Oregon's Sisters Folk Festival and COCC strike threat; Bend's warm, dry week ahead; Man Utd's quiet build-up to facing Tottenham; and the Seahawks' 12-game winning streak snapped by the Commanders.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Sunday, September 27, 2026
item.description: Claude's enzyme-system discovery and Anthropic's new safety/verification push; Salesforce's Agentforce Operations and record Q1 FY27 results; Russia-Ukraine peace talks stalling and a US-China AI safety channel; Ireland's presidential election; Bend drought and weather; Man Utd's draw at Fulham and Gary Neville's criticism; Seahawks' hot start behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Wednesday, September 23, 2026
item.description: Anthropic and Sam Altman both call to slow down frontier AI, plus the first AI-coordinated cyberattack; Salesforce hosted MCP pricing; Trump at the UN amid press-ban fallout and Yemen escalation; Ireland's youth exodus survey; Bend food costs and local weather; Man Utd's derby VAR fallout and Drew Lock's strong Seahawks start.

item.title: Daily Briefing — Friday, September 18, 2026
item.description: AI/Anthropic news (biology lab, data center deals), US-Iran tensions, Russia elections, Ireland headlines, Central Oregon wildfire relief, and Manchester United.
